source_review.notes: Checked seven official or primary sources. RFC 9745 defines the Deprecation Structured Field date, deprecation link relation, scope, ordering with Sunset, and the principle that deprecation does not itself change resource behavior. RFC 8594 defines Sunset as expected unresponsiveness and its HTTP-date/link semantics. RFC 9110 supports status and terminal-response semantics. OpenAPI 3.1 defines the operation deprecated flag. GraphQL defines @deprecated for fields and enum values with a reason. Google AIP-181 and Kubernetes document stability/deprecation/removal policy patterns and emergency or version-bound changes. Ecosystem-specific minimum periods are not generalized.
